from: August book, night 11 (For Such a Time as This)
p1: When Mordecai heard about Haman’s plan, he cried a loud, sad cry. Jews in every land cried too.
Mordecai sent a message to Queen Esther. “Please go to the king. Ask him to help your people.”
But there was a strict rule. No one could go to the king unless he called them. If the king held out his golden scepter, a gold stick, they were safe.
p2: Esther felt worried. But Mordecai said, “Who knows? Maybe you became queen for just a time like this.” Esther was in just the right place to help her people.
Heavenly Father has good things for you to do too, right where you are. Tomorrow, look for one person you can help.
old: Proud Haman made a wicked plan to hurt Heavenly Father’s people. Mordecai was very worried. He sent a message to Queen Esther, asking her to help. Esther felt afraid. Going to the king without being called could be dangerous. What should she do?
Then Mordecai said something wise: “Maybe Heavenly Father made you queen for this very reason — for such a time as this.”

Esther grew quiet and thought about her special purpose. Perhaps Heavenly Father had placed her right where she was to help save her people. Heavenly Father gives each of us a purpose, right where we are.
